Separating lifecycle stages:

- Health/readiness: service_healthy gates creation on db healthcheck; only at startup.

- Explicit operator restarts: restart: true restarts API after `docker compose restart db` (and other explicit Compose operations updating the dependency).
- Runtime restarts: explicitly excluded; nothing restarts API.
- Later DB failures: no ongoing gating; API readiness must be app-level (reconnect, readiness probe, circuit breaker). Can't promise sustained readiness.
